$comment: mergeGate.candidacyHoldIsNotCiFailure keeps review and draft promotion moving when merge-gate fails solely on candidacy holds (including labels-authority ledger holds) or a manual/shared freeze cleared after that job completed. Only non-candidates without ready-to-merge qualify; real gates, fail-closed or unreadable evidence remain red CI. Values: on|off, standard default on. Cascade: standard -> platform preferences -> repo settings -> MERGE_GATE_CANDIDACY_HOLD_IS_NOT_CI_FAILURE. Any invalid layer fails closed to off. off restores 'any merge-gate failure is red CI'. mergeGate.prEventCandidacyHoldsPass defers candidacy holds as skipped-by-policy only on pull_request events. Values: on|off, standard default on. Cascade: standard -> platform preferences -> repo scripts/settings/merge-gate.json -> MERGE_GATE_PR_EVENT_CANDIDACY_HOLDS_PASS. Any invalid layer fails closed to off. Safe because the drain enforces candidacy before enqueue and merge_group re-evaluates all gates. Fail-closed rows, real gates, and workflow-edit human-only review-acceptance holds remain blocking. off retains the original PR verdict.
